results.criterion: The file is a single HTML document with inline CSS and JavaScript and no build step.
results.note: One <style> and one <script> block, no external CSS or JS; mechanical check: scripts 1, 34 KB.

results.criterion: It has a menu section with categories and items, with prices shown as placeholders where unknown.
results.note: #menu has 3 .menu-cat blocks with 3 items each; every name and price is a .ph span.

results.criterion: It has an opening hours section.
results.note: #hours has a 7-row table, Monday to Sunday, each value a .ph placeholder.

results.criterion: It has a location section for Indiranagar, Bengaluru, with address and map or directions link, using placeholders where unknown.
results.note: #location has a placeholder address, phone and map pin, plus a Google Maps search link for Indiranagar Bengaluru. The page states it is neighbourhood-level only.

results.criterion: It has a pre-order for pickup section where a visitor can pick menu items and quantities, choose a pickup time, see a running total or item list, and get an order summary to send.
results.note: Steppers, #po-list, #po-total, #po-time and generate() with a Copy button are all present. Warning: #po-send has hidden but also class .btn with display:inline-block, so it shows with href='#' while SEND_CHANNEL.type is null.

results.criterion: It has a photo gallery section with at least 12 image slots, each with alt text, lazy loading and a marked placeholder where no real photo exists.
results.note: 12 figure.gallery-item elements, each with loading=lazy, a non-empty alt, data-placeholder and a .ph caption.

results.criterion: It has a farm stories section with three separate farm entries, each with a name, location, story text, and a photo slot, with placeholders where facts are unknown.
results.note: 3 article.farm entries, each with a figure photo slot (loading=lazy), h3 name, location line and 3 story paragraphs. All values are .ph, and the fact labels are blank placeholders.

results.criterion: A navigation bar links to the menu, hours, location, pre-order, gallery and farms sections.
results.note: The nav has links to #menu, #hours, #location, #preorder, #gallery and #farms; mechanical check: broken_in_page_links is empty.

results.criterion: The layout includes a responsive viewport meta tag and CSS breakpoints for small screens.
results.note: Viewport meta present; @media (max-width:768px) and (max-width:560px) defined; overflow_px 0 at 360px and 1280px.

results.criterion: Every placeholder is visibly marked in the page, and no invented phone numbers, prices or farm facts appear.
results.note: No digits-based phone, price or hours values found; all unknowns use .ph. Gallery subjects are labelled as suggestions. Medium confidence because the check was a read-through, not an automated scan.
